verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the docs' mention of Grok Bot, which hands "real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer", plus multi-agent research for multi-step research tasks. Both suggest agentic task execution, but neither says Grok drives a web browser, navigates sites or completes website actions for the user. missing for 10: explicit browser-operation/computer-use documentation, evidence of navigating and acting on websites (forms, clicks, logins), user controls/oversight for browser actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
